title: plain G1: setup6 refund rec7 core under plain wrapper (120.795395864889)

claims.statement: For the plain bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, uniform T=[x]P0 including identity, proof.md's algorithm returns canonical x with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT. For nonidentity T use z=e(T,Q0), h=e(P0,Q0), independent uniform b in [1,r), g=h^b; the cold STNFS core computes a=log_g(z) from two logarithms, and x=ba mod r is checked in G1. The core is the self-contained stnfs-k6 configuration: full setup6 refund on rec7 runs with optimal descent meter cap 113.285, f-only sieve with the exact FFT batch g test, f-only scan2 and the f-only norm-bound kernel, six owners, descent plan and meter 2^113.285. Core ledger <= 2^117.473467770001 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions): collection <= 2^116.783820000, linear algebra <= 2^115.814110851, both logarithms metered at 2^113.285; wrapper <= 2^80 instructions, a 2^66 row. The plain bound is strictly bounded by 10 * (2^117.473467770001 + 2^66) < 2^120.795395864889 G1 units (C=2,000), where the factor 10 is the C=20,000 to C=2,000 instruction-to-unit conversion. Core success >= 0.44557, >= 0.39 at +10% expected descent work. All cold construction, processors, failures, transfers and verification are included without amortization; no auxiliary powers, advice or amortisation. An analytic exploratory claim, not a practical break.
